selection: Qualitative, hypothesis-driven severity and coverage ranking. Original representative controls remain ranks 1-5; ranks 6-15 add ten document-body prompt-injection challenges (two per category); ranks 16-20 retain the earlier advanced variants. Rank is not an observed or guaranteed model-failure rate.
limitations: 65 synthetic inert fixtures; 20 explicitly ranked cases, ten-case default, six-turn SDK baseline. Live attack success is unverified until evaluated on the configured model. Worker tool-result injections are single fixed payloads, not adaptive attacks, real child execution, or emergent swarm collusion.
